name: Glossary
description: Explain your jargon where it appears. Terms you list get a dotted underline, and pointing at or tapping one shows what it means. No other setup.

panels.title: Glossary
panels.description: Words your visitors may not know, explained where they appear in your pages. Headings, links, buttons, the menu and the footer are left alone. Changes show on your pages right away.

fields.name: enabled
fields.title: Explain terms in the page text
fields.description: Turn this off to leave every page exactly as it was rendered, without losing your terms.

fields.name: terms
fields.title: Terms
fields.description: One per line: the term, a colon, then the explanation. For example: SEO: making your site easy to find in search engines. Separate other spellings with |, like SEO | search engine optimisation.

fields.name: every
fields.title: Mark every mention, not just the first on each page

fields.name: skip-pages
fields.title: Skip these pages
fields.description: Page addresses separated by commas, for example: home, legal/*. A * at the end means every page under it.
